contents.reason: Proposition 3.1 and its proof derive the Gaussian posterior on the Hilbert parameter space. The current theorem proves the exact coordinatewise moment identity and fixed-truth version support locally.

contents.reason: The source assumptions are used only to locate the boundary. The point-mass failure and version-equivalence argument are proved locally.
